encrypted.title: Encrypted records
encrypted.body: Health records are stored encrypted. Even platform staff cannot open them.

mfa.title: 2-step sign-in
mfa.body: A code from your phone keeps your account safe, even if someone learns your password.

verified.title: Verified organizations
verified.body: Clinics are checked by the platform before they can work with patient records.

shell.panelFootnote: Bio-Dosha-12 supports prevention and self-monitoring. It does not replace a doctor's examination.
shell.mobileTrust: Your health information is encrypted and protected.

errors.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, for example name@example.com.
errors.unavailable: We couldn't reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

password.rule: At least {min} characters. A short phrase of a few words is easy to remember and hard to guess.
password.tooLong: This password is too long. Please choose a shorter one.
password.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

notices.password_reset: Your password has been updated. Sign in with your new password.
notices.password_changed: Your password was changed and you were signed out on every device. Please sign in again.
notices.signed_out: You were signed out on every device.
notices.account_created: Your account has been created. Please sign in to continue.
notices.session_expired: Your session has ended (30 minutes without activity, or you were signed out). Please sign in again to keep your data protected.
notices.signed_out_here: You are signed out. You can sign in with another account.

signedIn.title: You're signed in
signedIn.subtitle: You are signed in as {email}.
signedIn.subtitleNoEmail: You are signed in on this device.
signedIn.switch: Sign out and use another account
signedIn.signOutFailed: Could not sign out. Please try again.
signedIn.hint: If several people share this computer, always sign out when you finish. You are signed out automatically after 30 minutes without activity.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Welcome. Sign in to continue to your account.

errors.credentials: The email or password is incorrect. Please check them and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. For your security, signing in is paused for 15 minutes. Please try again later, or reset your password.
errors.disabled: This account has been disabled. Please contact your organization or the system administrator.
errors.codeIncomplete: Enter all 6 digits of the code.
errors.codeInvalid: The code is incorrect or has expired. Enter the code your app shows right now.
errors.recoveryInvalid: This recovery code is incorrect or has already been used.

mfa.title: 2-step sign-in
mfa.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.recoverySubtitle: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you turned on 2-step sign-in.
mfa.codeHint: Open your authenticator app and find Bio-Dosha-12. The code changes every 30 seconds.
mfa.recoveryHint: Each recovery code works only once.
mfa.useApp: Use the code from my app instead
mfa.lostAccess: Lost your phone and your recovery codes? Contact the system administrator. After confirming who you are, they can reset 2-step sign-in for you.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: First, choose who the account is for.

individual.title: Personal
individual.desc: Track your own and your family's balance.

organization.title: Medical organization
organization.desc: For clinics, hospitals and private practices. Patient records open after the platform verifies your organization.

register.inviteHint: Working at a clinic that already uses Bio-Dosha-12? Ask its owner or manager for an invitation instead.
register.accountSectionOrgHint: You will be the organization's owner. Use your own name and email; colleagues get their own accounts when you invite them.
register.name: Full name
register.emailHint: You will sign in with this email.
register.consent: I have read the <link>Privacy Notice</link> and agree that my health information is stored and processed by Bio-Dosha-12.
register.consentOrg: I have read the <link>Privacy Notice</link> and agree that the health information my organization and I enter is stored and processed by Bio-Dosha-12.

next.title: What happens next
next.review: We review your organization, usually within one business day.
next.prepare: Meanwhile, set up 2-step sign-in and invite your colleagues.

errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists. <login>Sign in</login> or <forgot>reset your password</forgot>.
errors.consentRequired: Please accept the Privacy Notice to continue.
errors.orgNameRequired: Enter the organization's name (at least 2 characters).
errors.orgEmailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, or leave this field empty.
errors.fixAbove: Please check the fields marked above.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter the email you sign in with, and we'll send you a link to set a new password.

sent.title: Check your email
sent.body: If an account exists for {email}, we have sent it a link to set a new password.
sent.spam: Not there in a few minutes? Check your spam or junk folder.

disabled.title: Ask for a reset link
disabled.body: Password reset by email isn't available yet. The system administrator can create a reset link for you; if you work at a medical organization, its owner or manager can help you arrange it.

steps.contact: Contact your organization's owner or manager, or the system administrator, and tell them the email you sign in with.
steps.link: You will receive a one-time link. It works for 2 hours.
steps.set: Open the link and choose a new password.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.signOutNote: After the change you will be signed out on every device. Then sign in with your new password.

invalid.title: This link no longer works
invalid.body: It may have expired (links work for 2 hours), already been used, or been replaced by a newer link. Please request a new one.

invite.title: You're invited
invite.orgLead: {organization} invited you to work with them on Bio-Dosha-12.
invite.staffLead: You are invited to join the Bio-Dosha-12 platform team.
invite.mfa: To protect health records, this role requires 2-step sign-in. You will set it up right after accepting: it takes about 2 minutes and needs an authenticator app on your phone.
invite.pending: {organization} is waiting for verification by the platform. Patient records open after it is verified; until then you can set up your account and sign-in.
invite.suspended: Access for {organization} is currently suspended by the platform. Patient records stay closed until access is restored.

newAccount.title: Create your account
newAccount.emailHint: The invitation was sent to this email. You will sign in with it.
newAccount.otherSession: You are signed in as {current}. Accepting will create a new account for {email} and sign you in to it.
newAccount.consent: I have read the <link>Privacy Notice</link> and agree that my information is stored and processed by Bio-Dosha-12.

existing.otherTitle: This invitation is for a different account
existing.otherBody: You are signed in as {current}, but this invitation was sent to {email}. Sign out, then sign in with {email} to accept it.
existing.signedOutBody: An account with {email} already exists. Sign in with it to accept the invitation.

errors.planLimit: {organization} has reached the number of practitioners its plan allows. Please contact the organization's owner or manager; once a place is free, open this link again.
errors.loginRequired: An account with {email} already exists. Sign in with it, then accept the invitation.

invalid.title: This invitation no longer works
invalid.body: It may have expired (invitations work for 7 days), already been accepted, or been withdrawn. Please ask the person who invited you to send a new invitation.

owner.name: Owner
owner.desc: Runs the organization and works with patients.

manager.name: Manager
manager.desc: Manages members and settings. Has no access to patient records.

practitioner.name: Practitioner
practitioner.desc: Sees and records the organization's patients.

platformAdmin.name: Platform admin
platformAdmin.desc: Runs the control center: organizations, accounts and invitations. Cannot see health records.

platformOwner.name: Platform owner (superadmin)
platformOwner.desc: Everything a platform admin does, plus staff, plans and the audit log. Cannot see health records.

mfa.required: Your role requires 2-step sign-in. It protects patient and health records.

install.title: Protect your account with 2-step sign-in
install.why: Each time you sign in, you will enter your password and a 6-digit code from an app on your phone. Even if someone learns your password, they cannot sign in without your phone.
install.appsTitle: Install one of these free apps on your phone:
install.appsHint: Find it in the App Store (iPhone) or Google Play (Android).

scan.title: Scan the QR code
scan.body: Open the app, tap “+” or “Add account”, choose to scan a QR code, and point your phone's camera at this code.
scan.qrAlt: QR code for adding Bio-Dosha-12 to your authenticator app
scan.manualBody: In the app, choose “Enter a setup key”. Use your email as the account name, choose “Time-based” if asked, and type this key:
scan.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Please type the key instead.

confirm.title: Enter the code from the app
confirm.body: Your app now shows Bio-Dosha-12 with a 6-digit code that changes every 30 seconds. Enter the code shown now.
confirm.invalid: That code didn't work. Make sure the date and time on your phone are set automatically (in your phone's settings), then enter the code shown now.
confirm.restart: The setup was interrupted. Please start again. If Bio-Dosha-12 is already in your app, delete that entry first.

save.title: Save your recovery codes
save.body: If you lose your phone, you can sign in with one of these codes instead of the app code.
save.warning: These codes are shown only once, and each code works only once. Save them now: print them, download them or write them down, and keep them somewhere safe.
save.copiedNote: The codes were copied. Paste them somewhere safe, such as a password manager.
save.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Please download or print the codes instead.
save.ack: I saved my recovery codes in a safe place
save.ackRequired: Please confirm that you saved your recovery codes.

file.title: Bio-Dosha-12 — recovery codes
file.note: Each code works only once. Keep these codes private and in a safe place.

session.title: Please sign in again
session.body: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue setting up 2-step sign-in.
